observations: The page number «79» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 continues the sentence that ends p. 78 (JP2 0110, L32), «mit denen er die wahren täglichen».

The fractions of L02-L14 are case fractions, small figures over a short bar within the line, written {cf:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}: 33/60, 11/20, 2 25/60, 145/3600, 29/720, 5 7/8, 47/48, 29/30, 1/80, 33½, 16¾. L03: «2 25/60 ∶ 60», the colon of the division with a space on either side (20 and 21 px), written ∶ (U+2236).

L01-L08. Checked: 33′ = 33/60 = 11/20 of the daily motion of the sun gives its diameter (chapter 30 of the text, p. 22, JP2 0054); for the moon 2′ 25″ = 2 25/60 : 60 = 145/3600 = 29/720 of the daily motion; the text's 0;2,16 (note 1, and p. 23, JP2 0055, L04-L06) does not agree with its hourly rule, 0;58,10, which is 24 × 0;2,25,25. Al-Battānī's 5 7/8 : 6 = 47/48 of the hourly motion; 24 × 29/720 = 29/30; 47/48 − 29/30 = (235 − 232)/240 = 1/80.

L09-L14. Checked: 2′ 28″ × 24 = 59′ 12″; 59′ 12″ × 11/20 = 32′ 33.6″, «32′ 33½″», and half of it 16′ 16.8″, «16′ 16¾″»; 32′ 56″ × 24 = 13° 10′ 24″, and 13° 10′ 24″ × 29/720 = 31′ 50.1″, half of it 15′ 55″. The values of Table 63, 16′ 17″ and 15′ 58″, are to be compared with the table. L25-L26: 32′ 34″ and 31′ 50″, the diameters of L10 and L14 for 90° of anomaly, the mean distance.

L30: «Khaṇḍakhādyaka», in italics, with the dot under the ṇ and the macrons; L27 and L33 «Al-Bīrūnī» spaced; L34-L35 «Brahma-|guptas» spaced across the division. N02: «Ibid.», Nallino's edition of al-Battānī (p. 78, JP2 0110, N09).
The other colons and the semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-17 px measured; «Beispiel :», in italics, 10 px).
